goal: Help the developer choose an installer format that avoids surprising consumer UAC while preserving a viable enterprise deployment path.
must_include: Recommends a per-user NSIS `.exe`/assisted installer for the default consumer download when avoiding an immediate UAC prompt is more important than MSI enterprise semantics.
Explains that `msiWrapped` is an MSI launching an embedded NSIS installer, so the observed UAC and `.tmp` launch problem are from the MSI wrapper path, not from the app payload.
Frames MSIX as the right choice only if the app can accept package identity/containerization, signing, and MSIX/App Installer style updates.
Frames MSI/WiX as appropriate for managed per-machine deployment, Group Policy/SCCM/Intune-style enterprise installs, or explicit all-users installs that normally require elevation.
must_not: Claims `msiWrapped.impersonate: true` is enough to make the MSI wrapper a no-UAC per-user installer.
Treats code signing as the fix for every UAC prompt instead of distinguishing trust prompts from elevation prompts.
Recommends MSIX without mentioning package identity, signing, and the different update/deployment model.
Tells them to keep only MSI even though the stated default install goal is a non-admin per-user install.
acceptable_alternatives: Ship two artifacts: NSIS `.exe` for direct downloads and MSI/MSIX for enterprise administrators.
Use a native WiX MSI only for a managed all-users channel while keeping NSIS for self-service users.
Move to MSIX plus App Installer if the app benefits from package identity and clean updates more than traditional installer customization.
solved: The answer makes a clear NSIS-for-default, MSI/MSIX-for-specific-enterprise-or-identity decision and warns that the existing `msiWrapped` configuration is the wrong default path for no-UAC installs.
partial: The answer identifies `msiWrapped` as the source of the prompt but does not make a concrete MSI/MSIX/NSIS recommendation or omits the MSIX tradeoffs.
notes: The upstream issue was closed stale without a maintainer fix; grade recommendations by whether they avoid relying on `msiWrapped` for the default no-UAC consumer path.
